rules.section_title: Préambule > Preface
rules.rule_text: This fourth edition of the OECD Style Guide outlines the rules and conventions to be used in OECD writing.
rules.rule_summary: OECD writing doit suivre les règles et conventions définies dans ce guide de style.

rules.section_title: Préambule > Reader's guide
rules.rule_text: These rules and conventions apply to all OECD material, regardless of format or dissemination channel.
rules.rule_summary: Toutes les règles et conventions du guide s'appliquent à tout le matériel de l'OCDE, quel que soit le format ou le canal de diffusion.

rules.section_title: Préambule > Reader's guide > Revised structure
rules.rule_text: Advised to avoid these in the Spelling and usage chapter and the Translation and terms in other languages chapter.
rules.rule_summary: Il est conseillé d'éviter les mots et expressions étrangers selon les chapitres mentionnés.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > General rules
rules.rule_text: An abbreviation is a shortened form of a word or phrase (Prof for Professor or etc. for et cetera).
rules.rule_summary: Définit ce qu'est une abréviation dans le contexte du document.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > General rules
rules.rule_text: An acronym is a word formed from the initial letters of a phrase (OECD, EU). Acronyms can be pronounced letter by letter (OECD) or as a word (NATO).
rules.rule_summary: Définit ce qu'est un acronyme et précise les deux façons de le prononcer.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Abbreviations and acronyms
rules.rule_text: Always spell out the full form of a term on the first use in a document followed by the abbreviation or acronym in parentheses.
rules.rule_summary: La première utilisation d'un terme doit toujours être écrite en toutes lettres, suivie de l'abréviation ou de l'acronyme entre parenthèses.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Abbreviations and acronyms
rules.rule_text: Once introduced, use the abbreviation or acronym consistently throughout the text.
rules.rule_summary: Après introduction, l'abréviation ou l'acronyme doit être utilisé de manière cohérente dans tout le texte.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Abbreviations and acronyms
rules.rule_text: Always double check that the acronym is correct, referring to that used by source institution or entity.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut toujours vérifier que l'acronyme utilisé est correct et correspond à celui de l'institution source.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Abbreviations and acronyms
rules.rule_text: Use abbreviations and acronyms that are well known to your audience.
rules.rule_summary: Il est recommandé d'utiliser des abréviations et acronymes connus du public cible.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Abbreviations and acronyms
rules.rule_text: If you have many, or if you must use lesser-known ones for technical terms, provide a list of definitions.
rules.rule_summary: Si de nombreuses abréviations ou des termes techniques peu connus sont utilisés, il est recommandé de fournir une liste de définitions.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Abbreviations and acronyms
rules.rule_text: Only use abbreviations or acronyms in figures, infographics and tables if space constraints are significant.
rules.rule_summary: Les abréviations ou acronymes ne doivent être utilisés dans les figures, infographies et tableaux qu'en cas de contrainte d'espace significative.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Abbreviations and acronyms
rules.rule_text: Ensure that those used are explained in the surrounding text on first usage.
rules.rule_summary: Les abréviations ou acronymes utilisés doivent être expliqués dans le texte lors de leur première utilisation.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Abbreviations and acronyms
rules.rule_text: Use uppercase letters without full stops for acronyms, whether they are pronounced as a word (NATO) or read letter by letter (OECD).
rules.rule_summary: Les acronymes doivent être écrits en majuscules sans points, qu'ils soient prononcés comme un mot ou lettre par lettre.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Abbreviations and acronyms
rules.rule_text: For acronyms originating from another language, use the widely accepted English name in full and include original name and acronym in parentheses.
rules.rule_summary: Pour les acronymes d'une autre langue, il faut utiliser le nom anglais complet et inclure le nom et l'acronyme originaux entre parenthèses.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Abbreviations and acronyms
rules.rule_text: If the term is used frequently in the text, consider adding a list of all acronyms and abbreviations and use the original acronym in the text.
rules.rule_summary: Si le terme est fréquemment utilisé, il est recommandé d'ajouter une liste de tous les acronymes et abréviations et d'utiliser l'acronyme original dans le texte.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Abbreviations and acronyms
rules.rule_text: Use the " symbol when noting the copyright of an image or photo (@ Author name/Image bank name): @ J. Smith/Shutterstock.com.
rules.rule_summary: Le symbole @ doit être utilisé pour indiquer le copyright d'une image ou photo.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Abbreviations and acronyms
rules.rule_text: Use "the" before an acronym only if it is read letter by letter ("the UN" but "UNESCO" or "ESA" not "the ESA").
rules.rule_summary: L'article "the" ne doit être utilisé devant un acronyme que s'il se lit lettre par lettre.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Don't
rules.rule_text: Overuse acronyms and abbreviations; only introduce them if a term occurs frequently.
rules.rule_summary: Les acronymes et abréviations ne doivent être introduits que si un terme apparaît fréquemment.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Don't
rules.rule_text: Invent abbreviations or use non-standard ones.
rules.rule_summary: Il est déconseillé d'inventer ou d'utiliser des abréviations non standard.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Don't
rules.rule_text: Use full stops (periods) in common abbreviations and acronyms unless they are part of a formal name or established convention.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas utiliser de points dans les abréviations ou acronymes courants sauf si cela fait partie d'un nom officiel ou d'une convention établie.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Don't
rules.rule_text: Use an apostrophe when pluralising acronyms.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas utiliser d'apostrophe pour mettre les acronymes au pluriel.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Don't
rules.rule_text: Use "the" before the acronym if it being used as an adjective (OECD experts agreed ... ).
rules.rule_summary: Il est recommandé d'utiliser "the" devant un acronyme lorsqu'il est utilisé comme adjectif.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Don't
rules.rule_text: Abbreviate months or days of the week in full text, titles or subtitles; only abbreviate in figures, infographics or tables if space is limited.
rules.rule_summary: Les mois ou jours de la semaine ne doivent être abrégés que dans les figures, infographies ou tableaux si l'espace est limité.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Contracted titles
rules.rule_text: Honorifics to be placed before the last name: Mr for men, Ms for women, Mx for those who do not wish to use a gender-specific honorific
rules.rule_summary: Les titres honorifiques doivent être placés avant le nom de famille, avec Mr pour les hommes, Ms pour les femmes, et Mx pour les personnes ne souhaitant pas utiliser un titre genré.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Symbols and mathematical signs
rules.rule_text: Always place a non-breaking space before and after the symbols and signs in this table, except for "at" signs, asterisks and hashtags.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut toujours placer une espace insécable avant et après les symboles et signes du tableau, sauf pour les signes "at", les astérisques et les hashtags.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: The full form of an acronym in English always uses title case.
rules.rule_summary: Les formes développées des acronymes en anglais doivent toujours utiliser la casse de titre.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: The full form of an acronym in French always uses sentence case.
rules.rule_summary: Les formes développées des acronymes en français doivent toujours utiliser la casse phrase.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: A lowercase "s" can be added to an acronym in English when it refers to a plural term.
rules.rule_summary: Un "s" minuscule peut être ajouté à un acronyme anglais pour indiquer le pluriel.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: Acronyms never take an "s" in French; they are invariable.
rules.rule_summary: Les acronymes en français ne prennent jamais de "s" au pluriel et sont invariables.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: The "N" in "number" is in upper case while the "o" is in lower case and followed by a full stop (No. 59).
rules.rule_summary: Dans l'abréviation anglaise de "number", le "N" doit être en majuscule, le "o" en minuscule, suivi d'un point.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: The "n" in "numéro" is in lower case and the "o" in "numéro" is styled in superscript (nº 59).
rules.rule_summary: Dans l'abréviation française de "numéro", le "n" doit être en minuscule et le "o" en exposant.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: The abbreviation for "volume" is written with an upper case "V" (Vol. 6).
rules.rule_summary: L'abréviation anglaise de "volume" doit s'écrire avec un "V" majuscule.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: The abbreviation for "volume" is written with a lower case "v" (vol. 6).
rules.rule_summary: L'abréviation française de "volume" doit s'écrire avec un "v" minuscule.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: The abbreviation for "edition" can be singular or plural (ed. or eds.).
rules.rule_summary: L'abréviation anglaise de "edition" peut être au singulier ou au pluriel.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 1 Abbreviations, acronyms and signs > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: The abbreviation for "edition" must include the accent on the "e" (éd.).
rules.rule_summary: L'abréviation française de "édition" doit inclure l'accent sur le "e".

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > General rules
rules.rule_text: All OECD authors are required to provide the sources for concepts, data and quotations used in their publications.
rules.rule_summary: Tous les auteurs de l'OCDE doivent indiquer les sources des concepts, données et citations utilisés dans leurs publications.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > General rules
rules.rule_text: The OECD provides a citation tool, Mendeley, available through O.N.E Author.
rules.rule_summary: L'OCDE met à disposition un outil de citation, Mendeley, via O.N.E Author.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > General rules
rules.rule_text: Citing your sources as you draft saves time.
rules.rule_summary: Il est recommandé de citer ses sources au fur et à mesure de la rédaction pour gagner du temps.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing sources in-text
rules.rule_text: All source material, whether printed or digital, whether a publication or a media or multimedia product, can be cited in-text, following the rules below.
rules.rule_summary: Any type of source material is permitted to be cited in-text, provided the following rules are followed.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing sources in-text
rules.rule_text: Use the author-date system for in-text citations.
rules.rule_summary: The author-date system must be used for in-text citations.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing sources in-text
rules.rule_text: For one author, include the author's surname and the year of publication, as well as page number(s) if desired.
rules.rule_summary: For single-author works, the surname and year must be included; page numbers are optional.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing sources in-text
rules.rule_text: For up to three authors, list all; for four or more authors, use the first author's surname and "et al.".
rules.rule_summary: List all authors for up to three; for four or more, use the first author's surname and 'et al.'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing sources in-text
rules.rule_text: When several works are cited in the same place, cite them within parentheses, separated by semi-colons.
rules.rule_summary: Multiple works cited together must be separated by semi-colons within parentheses.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing sources in-text
rules.rule_text: The author(s) may also be cited by name followed by the publication date in parentheses.
rules.rule_summary: It is permitted to cite authors by name followed by the publication date in parentheses.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing sources in-text
rules.rule_text: For forthcoming works, list the author's surname and "forthcoming".
rules.rule_summary: For works not yet published, cite the author's surname and the word 'forthcoming'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing sources in-text
rules.rule_text: For unpublished works, list the author's surname and "unpublished".
rules.rule_summary: For unpublished works, cite the author's surname and the word 'unpublished'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing sources in-text
rules.rule_text: For works without a publication date, list the author's surname and "n.d.".
rules.rule_summary: For works with no publication date, cite the author's surname and 'n.d.'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing sources in-text
rules.rule_text: See the table "In-text citations" for examples.
rules.rule_summary: Refer to the provided table for citation examples.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing sources in-text
rules.rule_text: Ensure that for each source you cite in-text, the full citation appears in your reference list.
rules.rule_summary: Every in-text citation must have a corresponding full citation in the reference list.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Don't
rules.rule_text: Include excessive in-text citations in a single sentence, integrate them meaningfully.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas inclure un nombre excessif de citations dans une seule phrase ; les citations doivent être intégrées de manière pertinente.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Don't
rules.rule_text: Make generic statements without proper sourcing.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas faire de déclarations générales sans source appropriée.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Don't
rules.rule_text: Place source citations in footnotes or endnotes.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas placer les citations de sources en notes de bas de page ou en notes de fin.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing full sources in the references section
rules.rule_text: Include all sources cited in the text in your references section.
rules.rule_summary: Toutes les sources citées dans le texte doivent figurer dans la section des références.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing full sources in the references section
rules.rule_text: All media and multimedia sources, regardless of content type or format, must be cited in-text and :selected: in the appropriate reference section.
rules.rule_summary: Toutes les sources médias et multimédias doivent être citées dans le texte et dans la section de références appropriée.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing full sources in the references section
rules.rule_text: Style the author names as follows: :selected:
rules.rule_summary: Les noms des auteurs doivent être formatés selon les règles précisées ci-dessous.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing full sources in the references section
rules.rule_text: Style institutional author names as follows: :selected:
rules.rule_summary: Les noms des auteurs institutionnels doivent être formatés selon les règles précisées ci-dessous.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing full sources in the references section
rules.rule_text: Ensure that each entry contains all relevant information as outlined in the tables and examples :selected: below.
rules.rule_summary: Chaque entrée de la section des références doit contenir toutes les informations pertinentes comme indiqué dans les tableaux et exemples.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing full sources in the references section
rules.rule_text: Don't X Include materials not referenced in your text in the references section. :selected:
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit d'inclure dans la section des références des documents qui ne sont pas cités dans le texte.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing full sources in the references section
rules.rule_text: x Put hyperlinks behind a title; instead, include the URL at the end when appropriate. :selected:
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit de placer des hyperliens derrière un titre ; l'URL doit être incluse à la fin si nécessaire.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing reports
rules.rule_text: Author(s) (Year), Report title: Report subtitle, Publisher, City, Unique URL for identifier.
rules.rule_summary: Les citations de monographies autonomes doivent suivre ce format précis.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing reports
rules.rule_text: Author(s) (Year), Report title: Report subtitle, Series Title, No. Series Report Number, Publisher, City, Unique URL for identifier.
rules.rule_summary: Les citations de séries de rapports doivent suivre ce format précis.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing papers and articles
rules.rule_text: Author(s) (Year), "Paper title: Paper subtitle", Paper Series Title, No. Paper number [or Volume/Issue], Publisher, City, Unique URL for identifier.
rules.rule_summary: Les citations de policy papers ou working papers doivent suivre ce format bibliographique précis.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing papers and articles
rules.rule_text: Author(s) (Year), "Paper title: Paper subtitle", Publisher, City, Unique URL for identifier.
rules.rule_summary: Les citations de policy papers ou working papers sans série doivent suivre ce format bibliographique précis.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing papers and articles
rules.rule_text: Author(s) (Year), "Article title: Article subtitle", Journal Title: Journal Subtitle, Vol. Volume/Issue, page number(s), Unique URL for identifier.
rules.rule_summary: Les citations d'articles de revues doivent suivre ce format bibliographique précis.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing short content
rules.rule_text: Author(s) (Year), "Policy brief title: Policy brief subtitle", Publisher, City, Unique URL for identifier.
rules.rule_summary: Les citations de policy briefs doivent suivre ce format précis, incluant auteur, année, titre, éditeur, ville et URL unique.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing short content
rules.rule_text: Author(s) (Year), "Policy brief title: Policy brief subtitle", Policy Brief Series Title, No. Paper number [or No. Volume/Issue, Publisher, City, Unique URL for identifier.
rules.rule_summary: Les policy briefs faisant partie d'une série doivent être cités en incluant le titre de la série, le numéro du document ou volume/numéro, éditeur, ville et URL unique.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing short content
rules.rule_text: Author(s) (Year), "Country note title: Country note subtitle", Publisher, City, Unique URL for identifier (accessed on Day Month Year).
rules.rule_summary: Les country notes doivent être citées en incluant la date d'accès, en plus des informations standards.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing short content
rules.rule_text: Author(s) (Year), "Case study title: Case study subtitle", Publisher, City, Unique URL for identifier (accessed on Day Month Year).
rules.rule_summary: Les études de cas doivent être citées en suivant ce format, incluant la date d'accès.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2 Bibliographical references, citations and notes > Citing components
rules.rule_text: Author(s) (Year), "Chapter/annex title", in Report Title: Report Subtitle, Publisher, City, Unique URL for identifier.
rules.rule_summary: Les citations de chapitres ou annexes doivent suivre ce format précis, incluant auteur, année, titre, rapport, éditeur, ville et URL unique.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Citing databases and indicators (including for "OECD Data Explorer")
rules.rule_text: Author (year or n.d.), Indicator Title: Indicator Subtitle (indicator), Unique URL for identifier (accessed on Day Month Year).
rules.rule_summary: Les indicateurs doivent être cités en suivant ce format précis.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Citing databases and indicators (including for "OECD Data Explorer")
rules.rule_text: Author (Year or n.d.), Dataset Title: Dataset Subtitle (dataset), Unique URL for identifier (accessed on Day Month Year).
rules.rule_summary: Les jeux de données doivent être cités en suivant ce format précis.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Citing databases and indicators (including for "OECD Data Explorer")
rules.rule_text: Author (Year or n.d.), Datasets Group Title (dataset group), Unique URL for identifier (accessed on Day Month Year).
rules.rule_summary: Les groupes de jeux de données doivent être cités en suivant ce format précis.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Citing databases and indicators (including for "OECD Data Explorer")
rules.rule_text: Note: For citations from "OECD Data Explorer", please use its short link generator to create your URL by clicking "Share".
rules.rule_summary: Pour citer des données provenant de l'OECD Data Explorer, il est recommandé d'utiliser le générateur de liens courts via la fonction "Share".

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Citing media and multimedia

rules.rule_text: Author name or handle (Year), Text of post, Social Media Platform Title, Day Month published, Unique URL for identifier (accessed on Day Month Year).

rules.rule_text: Author(s) (Year), "Title of page/site", Blog Title, Unique URL for identifier (accessed on Day Month Year).

rules.rule_text: Author (Year), "Podcast title: Podcast subtitle", Podcast Series Title: Podcast Series Subtitle, Duration: duration value, Publisher, City, Unique URL for identifier.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Citing forthcoming, unpublished work, work without a publication date, or deceased authors
rules.rule_text: Use the correct citation style for the content type, replacing (Year) with (forthcoming); do not include a URL.
rules.rule_summary: Pour citer un travail à paraître, il faut utiliser le style de citation approprié et remplacer l'année par (forthcoming), sans inclure d'URL.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Citing forthcoming, unpublished work, work without a publication date, or deceased authors
rules.rule_text: Author(s) (unpublished), "Title: Subtitle". Do not include a URL.
rules.rule_summary: Pour citer un travail non publié, il faut indiquer l'auteur suivi de (unpublished) et du titre, sans inclure d'URL.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Citing forthcoming, unpublished work, work without a publication date, or deceased authors

rules.rule_summary: Pour citer un travail sans date de publication, il faut indiquer l'auteur suivi de (n.d.) et du titre, sans inclure d'URL.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Citing forthcoming, unpublished work, work without a publication date, or deceased authors
rules.rule_text: A "death dagger", represented by "t", may be added after the author's name.
rules.rule_summary: Il est permis d'ajouter un symbole de dague (t) après le nom de l'auteur pour indiquer une publication posthume.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Referencing legal documents and legislation
rules.rule_text: Legal references should generally include the key relevant information, such as the issuing body, document title, and date, as well as URL if available and date accessed if appropriate.
rules.rule_summary: Les références juridiques devraient inclure les informations clés comme l'émetteur, le titre, la date, l'URL si disponible et la date d'accès si approprié.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Referencing legal documents and legislation
rules.rule_text: When citing legal documentation, domestic citation standards should be followed (e.g. the case law of the French Conseil d'Etat should be cited in the same way that the Conseil d'État cites its own jurisprudence).
rules.rule_summary: Lors de la citation de documents juridiques, il est recommandé de suivre les normes nationales de citation.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Referencing legal documents and legislation
rules.rule_text: Many OECD Member countries maintain style guides for their national printing offices as well as databases of legislation, which may be consulted online.
rules.rule_summary: Les guides de style nationaux et les bases de données législatives peuvent être consultés en ligne.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Referencing legal documents and legislation
rules.rule_text: When citing legal documentation of other international organisations, the standards developed by those organisations should be followed (e.g. Directives of the European Parliament and of the Council should be cited according to EU practice).
rules.rule_summary: Lors de la citation de documents juridiques d'autres organisations internationales, il est recommandé de suivre leurs propres normes de citation.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Referencing legal documents and legislation
rules.rule_text: When referencing OECD legal instruments adopted by the OECD Council or within the framework of the OECD, the style will differ depending on whether the legal instrument is mentioned in the body of a text or included in the bibliography. Follow the examples in "Referencing OECD legal instruments".
rules.rule_summary: Pour référencer les instruments juridiques de l'OCDE, il faut suivre les exemples donnés selon qu'ils apparaissent dans le texte ou en bibliographie.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Referencing OECD legal instruments
rules.rule_text: In your text, take care to make clear to readers whether you are citing a revision of the instrument or its original date of entry into force and use the appropriate year in your citation.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut indiquer clairement si l'on cite une révision de l'instrument ou sa date d'entrée en vigueur, et utiliser l'année appropriée dans la citation.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Sources of boxes, figures, infographics and tables
rules.rule_text: Every box, figure, infographic and table must clearly cite its source or sources.
rules.rule_summary: All boxes, figures, infographics, and tables are required to clearly cite their sources.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Sources of boxes, figures, infographics and tables
rules.rule_text: Use the short reference system: Author(s) (Year), Title, Unique URL for identifier (if possible).
rules.rule_summary: The short reference system should be used for citations, including author, year, title, and URL if possible.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Sources of boxes, figures, infographics and tables
rules.rule_text: These sources must be included below the box, figure, infographic and table, and also in the appropriate reference section.
rules.rule_summary: Sources must be listed both below the visual element and in the reference section.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Sources of boxes, figures, infographics and tables
rules.rule_text: If your box, figure, infographic and table is a direct reproduction of an external source, without being adapted or modified, you must ensure you have the right to reproduce it. Citing the source is not enough.
rules.rule_summary: Direct reproductions of external sources require reproduction rights in addition to citation.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Sources of boxes, figures, infographics and tables
rules.rule_text: If you adapt a box, figure, infographic and table from another source, make this clear in your citation.
rules.rule_summary: Adaptations from other sources must be clearly indicated in the citation.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Sources of boxes, figures, infographics and tables
rules.rule_text: If the source is OECD work that is not accessible to the general public and is published for the first time in the work at hand, the publication and its material are the source. For boxes, there is no need to list the publication itself. For data, list the source of the data, even if not public ("Survey of ... /Country consultation ... "). Do not use "Source: OECD" or "Source: Authors".
rules.rule_summary: For unpublished OECD work, cite the publication and material as the source; for boxes, do not list the publication; for data, always list the data source and avoid generic attributions.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Notes
rules.rule_text: Notes provide additional information or commentary without interrupting the flow of the main text.
rules.rule_summary: Notes should only provide additional information or commentary and not disrupt the main text.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Notes
rules.rule_text: Notes are not used to provide sources.
rules.rule_summary: Notes must not be used to cite sources.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Notes
rules.rule_text: Use endnotes, not footnotes.
rules.rule_summary: Endnotes must be used instead of footnotes.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Notes
rules.rule_text: Use superscript 1, 2, 3 ... as note symbols.
rules.rule_summary: Superscript numbers must be used as note symbols.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Notes
rules.rule_text: Number endnotes consecutively by chapter (for reports) or throughout the text (papers, short content), using the automatic notes function in O.N.E Author.
rules.rule_summary: Endnotes must be numbered consecutively by chapter or throughout the text, using the automatic notes function.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Notes
rules.rule_text: Place endnote symbols after punctuation, either at the end of the sentence or within it if the note only refers to part of the sentence.
rules.rule_summary: Endnote symbols must be placed after punctuation, at the end of the sentence or within it as appropriate.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Don't
rules.rule_text: Use footnotes, as they disrupt the formatting of your manuscript in production.
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit d'utiliser des notes de bas de page car elles perturbent la mise en forme du manuscrit.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Don't
rules.rule_text: Place a note on a title or on a section heading.
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit de placer une note sur un titre ou un en-tête de section.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Notes in boxes, figures, infographics and tables
rules.rule_text: Notes in boxes, figures, infographics and tables are numbered separately from the main body text.
rules.rule_summary: Les notes dans les encadrés, figures, infographies et tableaux doivent être numérotées séparément du texte principal.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Notes in boxes, figures, infographics and tables
rules.rule_text: Insert note symbols manually as superscripted numerals in boxes, figures, infographics and tables.
rules.rule_summary: Les symboles de note doivent être insérés manuellement sous forme de chiffres en exposant dans les encadrés, figures, infographies et tableaux.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Don't
rules.rule_text: Place a note on the title.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas placer de note sur le titre.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Don't
rules.rule_text: Use notes to provide the source(s) for boxes, figures, infographics and tables.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut utiliser des notes pour indiquer la source des encadrés, figures, infographies et tableaux.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2025 3713cf73-en/full-report/highlights-from-the-2025-development-co-operation-peer-review-of-luxembourg- > Don't
rules.rule_text: Insert a note into a source, another note or an endnote.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas insérer une note dans une source, une autre note ou une note de fin.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > General rules
rules.rule_text: Capitalise the first letter of a word that begins a sentence and all proper nouns (names of events, persons, places, organisations, nationalities and languages).
rules.rule_summary: La première lettre d'un mot en début de phrase et tous les noms propres doivent être en majuscule.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > General rules
rules.rule_text: For titles and subtitles of books, periodicals and series, use title case.
rules.rule_summary: Les titres et sous-titres de livres, périodiques et séries doivent être en 'title case'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > General rules
rules.rule_text: For all other titles and subtitles, use sentence case. If a title includes a colon, capitalise the first word following the colon.
rules.rule_summary: Tous les autres titres et sous-titres doivent être en 'sentence case' et le premier mot après un deux-points doit être en majuscule.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > General rules
rules.rule_text: In most cases, specific terms may be capitalised; general terms should never be capitalised.
rules.rule_summary: Les termes spécifiques peuvent être en majuscule, mais les termes généraux ne doivent jamais l'être.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > OECD Members and Partners
rules.rule_text: Capitalise Member in "OECD Member", "OECD Members", "OECD Member country" and "OECD Member countries", as well as in "non-Member".
rules.rule_summary: Le mot 'Member' doit être écrit avec une majuscule dans les expressions spécifiées.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > OECD Members and Partners
rules.rule_text: Capitalise both words in Key Partners (Brazil, China, India, Indonesia and South Africa).
rules.rule_summary: Les deux mots de 'Key Partners' doivent être écrits avec une majuscule.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > OECD Members and Partners
rules.rule_text: Do not capitalise accession or accession candidate country.
rules.rule_summary: Les termes 'accession' et 'accession candidate country' ne doivent pas être écrits avec une majuscule.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > OECD Members and Partners
rules.rule_text: Capitalise Associate, Participant and Invitee if the terms are being used in the context of non-Member participation in the work of in OECD subsidiary bodies in line with the general principals set out in Revised Resolution of the Council on Partnerships in OECD Bodies [C(2012)100/REV2/FINAL].
rules.rule_summary: Les termes 'Associate', 'Participant' et 'Invitee' doivent être écrits avec une majuscule dans le contexte de la participation de non-Membres.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > OECD Members and Partners
rules.rule_text: Do not capitalise these terms when they are used as common nouns.
rules.rule_summary: Les termes mentionnés ne doivent pas être écrits avec une majuscule lorsqu'ils sont utilisés comme noms communs.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > OECD Members and Partners
rules.rule_text: Do not capitalise the term observer.
rules.rule_summary: Le terme 'observer' ne doit pas être écrit avec une majuscule.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Publications
rules.rule_text: Publication titles and subtitles use either title case or sentence case, depending on the content type (reports, papers, policy briefs, country notes and case studies).
rules.rule_summary: Les titres et sous-titres des publications doivent utiliser soit la casse titre, soit la casse phrase, selon le type de contenu.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Publications
rules.rule_text: In title case, each word is capitalised except for conjunctions or adverbs.
rules.rule_summary: En casse titre, chaque mot doit être en majuscule sauf les conjonctions ou adverbes.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Publications
rules.rule_text: In sentence case, only the first word is capitalised, except for any proper nouns included.
rules.rule_summary: En casse phrase, seul le premier mot doit être en majuscule, sauf pour les noms propres.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Publications
rules.rule_text: Use title case for report titles and subtitles, the names of projects or initiatives, and country notes when referring to the name of the "parent" publication.
rules.rule_summary: La casse titre doit être utilisée pour les titres et sous-titres de rapports, les noms de projets ou d’initiatives, et les notes pays pour le nom de la publication principale.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Publications
rules.rule_text: Use sentence case for the titles and subtitles of report chapters, papers and short content.
rules.rule_summary: La casse phrase doit être utilisée pour les titres et sous-titres des chapitres de rapports, des documents et des contenus courts.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Publications
rules.rule_text: For all other titles and subtitles (including those of boxes, figures, infographics and tables) use sentence case.
rules.rule_summary: La casse phrase doit être utilisée pour tous les autres titres et sous-titres, y compris ceux des encadrés, figures, infographies et tableaux.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Publications
rules.rule_text: Use sentence case references to specific components of a report (e.g. chapters, annexes, boxes, figures, infographics and tables).
rules.rule_summary: Les références aux composants spécifiques d’un rapport doivent être en casse phrase.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Don't
rules.rule_text: Capitalise the letter after a hyphen within a single word, even in titles or subtitles.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas mettre une majuscule après un trait d’union dans un mot, même dans les titres ou sous-titres.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Capitalising titles and subtitles
rules.rule_text: Report (title case)
rules.rule_summary: Les titres de rapports doivent être en 'title case'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Capitalising titles and subtitles
rules.rule_text: Working paper (sentence case)
rules.rule_summary: Les titres de working papers doivent être en 'sentence case'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Capitalising titles and subtitles
rules.rule_text: Policy paper (sentence case)
rules.rule_summary: Les titres de policy papers doivent être en 'sentence case'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Capitalising titles and subtitles
rules.rule_text: Policy brief (sentence case)
rules.rule_summary: Les titres de policy briefs doivent être en 'sentence case'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Capitalising titles and subtitles
rules.rule_text: Case study (sentence case)
rules.rule_summary: Les titres de case studies doivent être en 'sentence case'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Capitalising titles and subtitles
rules.rule_text: Country note (title case)
rules.rule_summary: Les titres de country notes doivent être en 'title case'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Capitalising titles and subtitles
rules.rule_text: Components (sentence case)
rules.rule_summary: Les titres des composants (chapitres, tableaux, etc.) doivent être en 'sentence case'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Other examples of capitalisation in titles
rules.rule_text: "e-commerce", "m-government" but "E-commerce" and "M-government" when starting a sentence or in a title.
rules.rule_summary: Les mots commençant par 'e-' ou 'm-' doivent être en minuscules sauf lorsqu'ils commencent une phrase ou apparaissent dans un titre, où ils prennent une majuscule.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Other examples of capitalisation in titles
rules.rule_text: Definite articles that are not formally part of a name
rules.rule_summary: Les articles définis ne doivent pas être en majuscule s'ils ne font pas formellement partie du nom.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Other examples of capitalisation in titles
rules.rule_text: the New York Times but The Economist
rules.rule_summary: L'article défini prend une majuscule uniquement s'il fait partie du nom officiel.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Other examples of capitalisation in titles
rules.rule_text:
Names of seasons

Always lowercase, unless part of a title.
rules.rule_summary: Les noms de saisons doivent toujours être en minuscules, sauf s'ils font partie d'un titre.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Proper nouns and official titles
rules.rule_text: Capitalise official titles and roles when used as part of a proper noun or title ("Secretary-General", "Minister of Finance").
rules.rule_summary: Les titres officiels et les fonctions doivent être écrits avec une majuscule lorsqu'ils font partie d'un nom propre ou d'un titre.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Proper nouns and official titles
rules.rule_text: Capitalise the names of groups, organisations and institutions if they are proper nouns or if the reference is specific ("the OECD", "the Working Party on Countering Illicit Trade").
rules.rule_summary: Les noms de groupes, d'organisations et d'institutions doivent être écrits avec une majuscule s'ils sont des noms propres ou si la référence est spécifique.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Don't
rules.rule_text: Don't: Capitalise generic references to roles, organisations, institutions, bodies or documents.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas mettre une majuscule aux références génériques à des rôles, organisations, institutions, organes ou documents.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Compass points
rules.rule_text: Compass points may be capitalised in some circumstances, in order to clarify whether the term refers to a specific or a general direction.
rules.rule_summary: La capitalisation des points cardinaux est permise dans certains cas pour clarifier le sens.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Compass points
rules.rule_text: Capitalise compass points as appropriate when part of a title.
rules.rule_summary: Les points cardinaux doivent être en majuscule lorsqu'ils font partie d'un titre.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Compass points
rules.rule_text: Capitalise compass points when referring to specific regions or when part of a proper noun.
rules.rule_summary: Les points cardinaux doivent être en majuscule lorsqu'ils désignent des régions spécifiques ou font partie d'un nom propre.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Compass points
rules.rule_text: Use lowercase when referring to a compass point generically to describe direction.
rules.rule_summary: Les points cardinaux doivent être en minuscule lorsqu'ils décrivent une direction de manière générique.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Don't
rules.rule_text: X Hyphenate intercardinal directions (Northeast, Southeast, Southwest and Northwest).
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit de mettre un trait d’union dans les directions intercardinales comme Northeast, Southeast, Southwest et Northwest.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Don't
rules.rule_text: X Use the term "Eastern European" when referring to any OECD member country. Instead use :selected: "Central and Eastern European".
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit d’utiliser le terme « Eastern European » pour désigner un pays membre de l’OCDE ; il faut utiliser « Central and Eastern European ».

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > Capitalisation for specific versus generic terms
rules.rule_text: Generally, specific terms may be capitalised while generic references never should be.
rules.rule_summary: La capitalisation des termes spécifiques est autorisée, tandis que la capitalisation des références génériques est déconseillée.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > When to capitalise ... or not
rules.rule_text: the Renaissance, the French Revolution, World War II but the past decade, for a century
rules.rule_summary: Les noms de périodes historiques spécifiques doivent être écrits avec une majuscule, tandis que les périodes génériques ne le sont pas.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > When to capitalise ... or not
rules.rule_text: the Internet, the OECD Intranet but a web page, a website, a web manager
rules.rule_summary: Les termes Internet et OECD Intranet doivent être écrits avec une majuscule, tandis que les termes génériques comme web page, website, web manager ne le sont pas.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > When to capitalise ... or not
rules.rule_text: The 1965 Road Act but The act was passed by simple majority
rules.rule_summary: Les noms d'actes législatifs spécifiques doivent être écrits avec une majuscule, tandis que le mot générique 'act' ne l'est pas.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > When to capitalise ... or not
rules.rule_text: The Open Government Directive establishes deadlines for action but A directive is a legislative act of the European Union
rules.rule_summary: Les noms de directives spécifiques doivent être écrits avec une majuscule, tandis que le terme générique 'directive' ne l'est pas.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > When to capitalise ... or not
rules.rule_text: The Privatisation Bill but Congress is debating a bill
rules.rule_summary: Les noms de projets de loi spécifiques doivent être écrits avec une majuscule, tandis que le terme générique 'bill' ne l'est pas.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > When to capitalise ... or not
rules.rule_text: The OECD Council Decision on ... but Their decision was unanimous
rules.rule_summary: Les décisions spécifiques du Conseil de l'OCDE doivent être écrites avec une majuscule, tandis que le terme générique 'decision' ne l'est pas.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > When to capitalise ... or not
rules.rule_text: The Ministerial Declaration on the Protection of Privacy of Global Networks but The group adopted a declaration
rules.rule_summary: Les déclarations ministérielles spécifiques doivent être écrites avec une majuscule, tandis que le terme générique 'declaration' ne l'est pas.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > When to capitalise ... or not
rules.rule_text: The Resolution of the Council on the Draft Convention on the Protection of Foreign Property was adopted in 1967 but Council will review two resolutions
rules.rule_summary: Les résolutions spécifiques du Conseil doivent être écrites avec une majuscule, tandis que le terme générique 'resolution' ne l'est pas.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > When to capitalise ... or not
rules.rule_text: OECD Guidelines on the Protection of Privacy but OECD Members called for new guidelines
rules.rule_summary: Les lignes directrices spécifiques de l'OCDE doivent être écrites avec une majuscule, tandis que le terme générique 'guidelines' ne l'est pas.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 3 Capitalisation > When to capitalise ... or not
rules.rule_text: The last Ministerial Council Meeting ended in agreement but The OECD Council meets at ministerial level once a year
rules.rule_summary: Les réunions ministérielles spécifiques doivent être écrites avec une majuscule, tandis que le terme générique 'ministerial' ne l'est pas.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers
rules.rule_text: To avoid this, follow the guidance provided by the Directorate for Legal Affairs and the Directorate for Communications regarding country and territory names and codes, currency codes and symbols, territorial disclaimers, and maps.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut suivre les directives des directions concernées pour les noms, codes, devises et cartes des pays et territoires.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Country and territory names
rules.rule_text: The OECD has specific naming and style conventions for Members, non-Members, Key Partners and accession candidate countries.
rules.rule_summary: OECD applies specific naming and style conventions for different country categories.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Country and territory names
rules.rule_text: The Directorate for Legal Affairs (LEG) provides a list of the official country and territory long names, short names, names in lists, tables, maps and graphics, and ISO codes, to be used in OECD content:
rules.rule_summary: LEG provides the official list of country and territory names and codes for OECD content.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Country and territory names
rules.rule_text: If in doubt, or if asked to apply different naming, contact LEGILU@oecd.org for clarification.
rules.rule_summary: Contact LEG for clarification if unsure or asked to use different naming.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Country and territory names
rules.rule_text: Use these names in all content, regardless of format and of whether it is published externally or remains internal.
rules.rule_summary: Official names must be used in all OECD content, internal or external.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Country and territory names
rules.rule_text: Remember that there are small differences in spelling between many names in English and French; always check the spelling is correct for the language in which you are drafting and refer to the table at the end of this chapter.
rules.rule_summary: Always verify correct spelling for the drafting language and refer to the provided table.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Country and territory names
rules.rule_text: Only use the country and territory names and codes included in the list provided by LEG.
rules.rule_summary: Use exclusively the names and codes from the LEG-provided list.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Country and territory names
rules.rule_text: Use the long name the first time a country or territory is mentioned in the text of the document, define the short name for what follows, then use the short name thereafter.
rules.rule_summary: First mention: use long name and define short name; use short name afterwards.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Country and territory names
rules.rule_text: Add "the" before these countries: the Netherlands, the Russian Federation, the Slovak Republic, the United Kingdom and the United States. These countries always take the singular verb form.
rules.rule_summary: Always use 'the' before specified country names and use singular verb form.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Country and territory names
rules.rule_text: Use "Euro area" when referring to the 20 EU Member States that use the euro.
rules.rule_summary: Refer to the 20 EU countries using the euro as 'Euro area'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Country and territory names
rules.rule_text: Spell out country and territory names in full when used as nouns (the United States, the United Kingdom) but use abbreviations when used as adjectives (US companies, UAE delegates, UK unions).
rules.rule_summary: Full names for nouns; abbreviations for adjectives.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Country and territory names
rules.rule_text: Always list countries and territories alphabetically (in English) in text unless LEG's list advises otherwise. Take care to check in LEG's list for any exceptions; for example, the People's Republic of China is listed under "C" (China, the People's Republic of). If no letter is specified, the entry is under the first letter of the country or territory's name ("R" for the Russian Federation).
rules.rule_summary: List countries alphabetically in English unless LEG specifies otherwise; check for exceptions.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Country and territory names
rules.rule_text: Countries and territories may be listed non-alphabetically if there is a specific reason for another order, such as a ranking.
rules.rule_summary: Non-alphabetical order is permitted for specific reasons like rankings.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Don't
rules.rule_text: Use any names for countries or territories that differ from those in the list provided by LEG under :selected: any circumstances.
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit d'utiliser des noms de pays ou territoires différents de ceux fournis par LEG dans la liste sélectionnée, en toutes circonstances.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Visual representations of countries and territories
rules.rule_text: use such representations only with moderation and caution.
rules.rule_summary: Les représentations visuelles de pays ou territoires doivent être utilisées avec modération et prudence.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Visual representations of countries and territories
rules.rule_text: Use the map model proposed by LEG https://portal.oecd.org/eshare/leg/Pages/Home.aspx.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut utiliser le modèle de carte proposé par LEG.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Visual representations of countries and territories
rules.rule_text: Follow the technical guidance and list of points to verify provided by LEG.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut suivre les instructions techniques et la liste de vérification fournies par LEG.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Visual representations of countries and territories
rules.rule_text: If you must use a flag image, only use a flag to designate a country, never for a territory.
rules.rule_summary: Si une image de drapeau doit être utilisée, elle ne doit servir qu'à désigner un pays, jamais un territoire.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Visual representations of countries and territories
rules.rule_text: Verify that the flag is the correct one for the country, as flags change over time.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut vérifier que le drapeau utilisé est bien celui du pays concerné.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Do not
rules.rule_text: Do not import flag symbols into the back office of OECD.org (AEM). Only use the flag symbols provided by AEM itself.
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit d'importer des symboles de drapeaux dans le back office d'OECD.org (AEM) ; seuls les symboles fournis par AEM doivent être utilisés.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Do not
rules.rule_text: Do not use emojis to represent flags.
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit d'utiliser des emojis pour représenter des drapeaux.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > ISO country and territory codes
rules.rule_text: ISO codes for countries and territories should generally be avoided, as the ISO country and territory names to which they relate do not align with OECD practice.
rules.rule_summary: Il est recommandé d'éviter l'utilisation des codes ISO pour les pays et territoires, car leurs noms ne correspondent pas à la pratique de l'OCDE.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > ISO country and territory codes
rules.rule_text: In cases where the use of ISO codes is necessary, a table setting out the ISO codes and the country or territory names to which they relate (in line with LEG guidance) should be added in a reader's guide.
rules.rule_summary: Si l'utilisation des codes ISO est nécessaire, il est recommandé d'ajouter un tableau récapitulatif dans le guide du lecteur, conformément aux directives LEG.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > ISO country and territory codes
rules.rule_text: Consult LEG's "List of names of countries and territories and related guidelines" available at https://portal.oecd.org/eshare/leg/Pages/Home.aspx.
rules.rule_summary: Il est recommandé de consulter la liste LEG des noms de pays et territoires et les directives associées.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > ISO currency codes
rules.rule_text: Currencies can be designated by terms, codes or symbols.
rules.rule_summary: Les devises peuvent être désignées par des termes, des codes ou des symboles.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > ISO currency codes
rules.rule_text: To avoid confusion, use the ISO code for specific currencies and the term for generic references. The budget is USD 5 million but the budget is millions of dollars.
rules.rule_summary: Pour éviter toute confusion, il faut utiliser le code ISO pour les devises spécifiques et le terme pour les références génériques.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > ISO currency codes
rules.rule_text: Use the currency code in publications, short content and web copy.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut utiliser le code de la devise dans les publications, contenus courts et sur le web.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > ISO currency codes
rules.rule_text: Use the currency symbol if necessary due to space constraints in social media or in figures and tables.
rules.rule_summary: Le symbole monétaire peut être utilisé si l'espace est limité sur les réseaux sociaux ou dans les tableaux/figures.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > ISO currency codes
rules.rule_text: Place the code before the amount (USD 1 000), separated by a hard space; place symbol before the amount without a space ($1 000). Place the term after the amount (1 000 dollars), separated by a hard space.
rules.rule_summary: Le code doit précéder le montant avec une espace insécable ; le symbole précède sans espace ; le terme suit le montant avec une espace insécable.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > ISO currency codes
rules.rule_text: Define uncommon currency codes on first use in the text. In order to finance the merger, the company raised KGS 5 million (Kyrgyz Republic soms).
rules.rule_summary: Les codes de devises peu courants doivent être définis lors de leur première utilisation dans le texte.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > ISO currency codes
rules.rule_text: For uncommon currencies, indicate the equivalent in a more common currency (EUR, USD). The bank allocated IQD 1 billion (USD 750 millions) to the project.
rules.rule_summary: Pour les devises peu courantes, il est recommandé d'indiquer l'équivalent dans une devise plus courante.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > ISO currency codes
rules.rule_text: For web and social media content, currency symbols can be used, but replace with currency codes :selected: if there is a risk of confusion.
rules.rule_summary: Les symboles monétaires peuvent être utilisés sur le web et les réseaux sociaux, mais doivent être remplacés par des codes en cas de risque de confusion.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > ISO currency codes
rules.rule_text: Refer to the tables below for the currency names, codes and symbols for OECD Members and the :selected: euro area.
rules.rule_summary: Il est recommandé de se référer aux tableaux pour les noms, codes et symboles des devises des membres de l'OCDE et de la zone euro.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Don't
rules.rule_text: Don't Mix currency terms, codes and symbols. Be consistent.
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit de mélanger les termes, codes et symboles de devises ; il faut être cohérent dans leur utilisation.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Currencies and their ISO codes for OECD Member countries and the euro area
rules.rule_text: Currencies and their ISO codes for OECD Member countries and the euro area
rules.rule_summary: Les devises et leurs codes ISO doivent être utilisés pour les pays membres de l'OCDE et la zone euro.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 4 Country and territory names, codes and currencies, and territorial disclaimers > Currencies and their ISO codes for OECD Member countries and the euro area
rules.rule_text:
