rules.rule_text: Put parentheses "( )" around an ellipsis.
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit de placer des parenthèses autour d'un point de suspension.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 11 Punctuation > Don't
rules.rule_text: Put spaces between the dots in an ellipsis.
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit de mettre des espaces entre les points d'un point de suspension.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 11 Punctuation > En-dash
rules.rule_text: Use an en-dashes in pairs to set off information that is not part of the main sentence, but which you wish to highlight or stress.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut utiliser des tirets en-pair pour isoler des informations non essentielles mais à mettre en valeur.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 11 Punctuation > En-dash
rules.rule_text: Use a space before and after each en-dash.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut insérer une espace avant et après chaque tiret en.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 11 Punctuation > En-dash
rules.rule_text: Use one en-dash to add a phrase explaining or elaborating on what has gone before.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut utiliser un seul tiret en pour ajouter une explication ou un complément à la phrase précédente.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 11 Punctuation > Don't
rules.rule_text: Use dashes - of any kind - in titles.
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit d'utiliser des tirets, de quelque type que ce soit, dans les titres.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 11 Punctuation > Don't
rules.rule_text: Combine dashes with other punctuation; an interjected phrase that starts with a dash must end with one.
rules.rule_summary: Une phrase intercalée qui commence par un tiret doit se terminer par un tiret.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 11 Punctuation > Don't
rules.rule_text: Use em-dashes
rules.rule_summary: Il est obligatoire d'utiliser des tirets cadratins (em-dashes).

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x
rules.rule_text: Do not use in OECD work
rules.rule_summary: L'utilisation du tiret cadratin (em-dash) est interdite dans les travaux de l'OCDE.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Exclamation mark
rules.rule_text: Exclamation marks are not used in formal writing.
rules.rule_summary: L'utilisation du point d'exclamation est interdite dans les écrits formels.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Exclamation mark
rules.rule_text: They may be used very sparingly in informal writing.
rules.rule_summary: Les points d'exclamation peuvent être utilisés avec parcimonie dans les écrits informels.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Forward slash
rules.rule_text: / Use for a period overlapping two calendar years.
rules.rule_summary: Le slash doit être utilisé pour indiquer une période couvrant deux années civiles.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Forward slash
rules.rule_text: / Use in ratios.
rules.rule_summary: Le slash doit être utilisé pour exprimer des ratios.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Don't
rules.rule_text: Use a slash mark (/) to replace "or".
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas utiliser une barre oblique pour remplacer "ou".

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Don't
rules.rule_text: To go through customs you may present your ID card, passport or both.
rules.rule_summary: Pour passer la douane, il est permis de présenter sa carte d'identité, son passeport ou les deux.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Don't
rules.rule_text: Use "and/or" when "or" is sufficient.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas utiliser "et/ou" lorsque "ou" suffit.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Don't
rules.rule_text: Use a slash for a period of two or more full years; instead, use a hyphen.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas utiliser une barre oblique pour une période de deux années complètes ou plus ; il faut utiliser un trait d'union.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Don't
rules.rule_text: 2017-2019 (but 2017/19 is correct to indicate a period that overlaps two years but is less than two full years).
rules.rule_summary: On doit utiliser un trait d'union pour une période de deux années complètes ou plus, mais une barre oblique est correcte pour une période qui chevauche deux années mais est inférieure à deux années complètes.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Don't
rules.rule_text: Use a slash to link terms that are usually linked by a hyphen.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas utiliser une barre oblique pour relier des termes habituellement reliés par un trait d'union.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Don't
rules.rule_text: Replace "per", "a" or "an" with a slash with units of measure.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas remplacer "par", "un" ou "une" par une barre oblique dans les unités de mesure.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Full stop (period)
rules.rule_text: Use a full stop to complete a sentence and follow it by a space.
rules.rule_summary: A full stop must be used to end a sentence, and a space must follow it.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Full stop (period)
rules.rule_text: Place a full stop at end of all paragraphs.
rules.rule_summary: Every paragraph must end with a full stop.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Full stop (period)
rules.rule_text: Put the full stop inside quotation marks when it ends the quotation as well as the sentence in which it appears.
rules.rule_summary: If a quotation and the sentence both end together, the full stop must be placed inside the quotation marks.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Full stop (period)
rules.rule_text: Place the full stop outside quotation marks where the quotation itself does not end with a full stop.
rules.rule_summary: If the quotation does not end with a full stop, the full stop must be placed outside the quotation marks.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Full stop (period)
rules.rule_text: Place a full stop after abbreviations such "etc." and where generally customary ("i.e." or "e.g.").
rules.rule_summary: A full stop must be placed after abbreviations like 'etc.', 'i.e.', and 'e.g.' where customary.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Full stop (period)
rules.rule_text: Include full stops when needed to avoid confusion.
rules.rule_summary: Full stops should be included wherever necessary to prevent confusion.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Don't
rules.rule_text: Use a full stop after headings, titles, or bulleted items unless they form a complete sentence.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas utiliser de point après les titres, en-têtes ou éléments de liste à puces, sauf s'ils forment une phrase complète.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Don't
rules.rule_text: Use a full stop if an abbreviation consists of the first and last letters of a word: Mr, Ms, Ltd, Dr.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut utiliser un point après une abréviation composée de la première et de la dernière lettre d'un mot.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Lists
rules.rule_text: Numbered lists are run into the text and can use Arabic numbers (1, 2, 3), Roman numerals (i, ii, iii) or lowercase letters (a, b, c) as long as the choice is applied consistently.
rules.rule_summary: Numbered lists may use Arabic numbers, Roman numerals, or lowercase letters, but the chosen style must be applied consistently.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Lists
rules.rule_text: Use lists sparingly, to avoid interrupting the flow of your text.
rules.rule_summary: It is recommended to use lists sparingly to maintain the flow of the text.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Lists
rules.rule_text: Apply the same grammatical structure to each item in the list.
rules.rule_summary: Each item in a list must follow the same grammatical structure.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Lists
rules.rule_text: For lists with complete sentences, use a capital letter to start the first word, and a full stop.
rules.rule_summary: Complete sentences in lists must start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Lists
rules.rule_text: For list with incomplete sentences, use a lowercase letter to start the first word and no punctuation.
rules.rule_summary: Incomplete sentences in lists must start with a lowercase letter and have no ending punctuation.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Lists
rules.rule_text: Use bullet points, numbers (Arabic numbers or Roman numerals) or lowercase letters in roman type, to mark the items in the list.
rules.rule_summary: List items must be marked with bullet points, numbers, or lowercase letters in roman type.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Types of lists
rules.rule_text: Consult COM Support if you have questions.
rules.rule_summary: Il est recommandé de consulter le support COM en cas de questions.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Types of lists
rules.rule_text: Submit your Kappa form six weeks in advance.
rules.rule_summary: Il est obligatoire de soumettre le formulaire Kappa six semaines à l'avance.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Types of lists
rules.rule_text: Keep the publications team in COM appraised of any unexpected changes or delays.
rules.rule_summary: Il est obligatoire de tenir l'équipe des publications informée de tout changement ou retard imprévu.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Types of lists
rules.rule_text: Send the complete manuscript to TRA as early as possible.
rules.rule_summary: Il est recommandé d'envoyer le manuscrit complet à TRA dès que possible.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > 3. Girls and boys perform better in reading when they read for pleasure in their free time.
rules.rule_text: The following components are essential to your publication:
rules.rule_summary: La publication doit inclure les composants listés comme essentiels.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > 3. Girls and boys perform better in reading when they read for pleasure in their free time.
rules.rule_text: Title page
rules.rule_summary: La publication doit comporter une page de titre.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > 3. Girls and boys perform better in reading when they read for pleasure in their free time.
rules.rule_text: Copyright page
rules.rule_summary: La publication doit comporter une page de copyright.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > 3. Girls and boys perform better in reading when they read for pleasure in their free time.
rules.rule_text: Foreword
rules.rule_summary: La publication doit comporter une préface.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > 3. Girls and boys perform better in reading when they read for pleasure in their free time.
rules.rule_text: Executive summary
rules.rule_summary: La publication doit comporter un résumé exécutif.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Parentheses
rules.rule_text: Use sparingly to avoid jarring the reader; often commas can replace parentheses.
rules.rule_summary: Il est recommandé d'utiliser les parenthèses avec parcimonie pour ne pas gêner la lecture, et de préférer les virgules lorsque cela est possible.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Parentheses
rules.rule_text: Put the full stop before the closing parentheses mark if the phrase in parentheses is a complete sentence.
rules.rule_summary: Le point final doit être placé avant la parenthèse fermante si la phrase entre parenthèses est une phrase complète.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Parentheses
rules.rule_text: Put the full stop after the closing parentheses mark if the phrase in parentheses is not a complete sentence.
rules.rule_summary: Le point final doit être placé après la parenthèse fermante si la phrase entre parenthèses n'est pas une phrase complète.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Question mark
rules.rule_text: Question marks are used to indicate direct questions.
rules.rule_summary: Les points d'interrogation doivent être utilisés pour indiquer des questions directes.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Question mark
rules.rule_text: Use to mark direct questions, replacing the full stop.
rules.rule_summary: Le point d'interrogation doit remplacer le point pour marquer une question directe.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Question mark
rules.rule_text: Use a capital letter to start the first word after the question mark.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut utiliser une majuscule pour commencer le premier mot après un point d'interrogation.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Don't
rules.rule_text: X Use a question mark for indirect questions.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas utiliser de point d'interrogation pour les questions indirectes.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Quotation marks
rules.rule_text: Quotation marks come in pairs: one mark to open the quote and another to close it.
rules.rule_summary: Quotation marks must always be used in pairs, with one to open and one to close.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Quotation marks
rules.rule_text: Single quotation marks are indicated with (''), while double quotation marks are indicated with (" "). Each are used in different ways.
rules.rule_summary: Single and double quotation marks are represented differently and have distinct uses.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Quotation marks
rules.rule_text: Quotation marks enclose direct speech, quotations, titles or terms.
rules.rule_summary: Quotation marks are used to enclose direct speech, quotations, titles, or terms.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Quotation marks
rules.rule_text: Use double quotation marks for direct speech, short quotations, titles or terms.
rules.rule_summary: Double quotation marks should be used for direct speech, short quotations, titles, or terms.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Quotation marks
rules.rule_text: Use single quotation marks for quotes within quotes
rules.rule_summary: Single quotation marks should be used for quotations within quotations.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Quotation marks
rules.rule_text: Place punctuation after the quotation mark when the quoted material does not end a sentence.
rules.rule_summary: Punctuation should be placed after the quotation mark if the quoted material does not end the sentence.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Quotation marks
rules.rule_text: Place punctuation within the quotation mark if the quoted material ends with a full stop.
rules.rule_summary: Punctuation should be placed inside the quotation mark if the quoted material ends with a full stop.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Quotation marks
rules.rule_text: Put punctuation after the close quotation mark if the quoted material itself does not end with a full stop and ends the sentence.
rules.rule_summary: Punctuation should be placed after the closing quotation mark if the quoted material does not end with a full stop but ends the sentence.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Don't
rules.rule_text: x Use any quotation marks to set off quotations longer than five lines.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas utiliser de guillemets pour encadrer des citations de plus de cinq lignes.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Don't
rules.rule_text: x Use single quotation marks for stand-alone terms.
rules.rule_summary: Il ne faut pas utiliser de guillemets simples pour les termes isolés.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Semi-colon
rules.rule_text: Use semi-colons to join related clauses.
rules.rule_summary: Les points-virgules doivent être utilisés pour relier des propositions connexes.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Semi-colon
rules.rule_text: Separate items in complex lists that contain commas.
rules.rule_summary: Les éléments dans des listes complexes contenant des virgules doivent être séparés par des points-virgules.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Don't
rules.rule_text: Don't Use semi-colons in simple lists.
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit d'utiliser des points-virgules dans des listes simples.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Don't
rules.rule_text: Don't Use semi-colons and colons interchangeably.
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit d'utiliser les points-virgules et les deux-points de manière interchangeable.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Square brackets
rules.rule_text: Use square brackets are used within other forms of punctuation, usually parentheses, to provide additional information or explanation.
rules.rule_summary: Les crochets doivent être utilisés à l'intérieur d'autres signes de ponctuation, généralement des parenthèses, pour fournir des informations ou des explications supplémentaires.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Square brackets
rules.rule_text: Use within direct quotes to note information not in the original.
rules.rule_summary: Les crochets doivent être utilisés dans les citations directes pour indiquer des informations absentes de l’original.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: Spaces are not placed between the last word and before punctuation, only after it.
rules.rule_summary: En anglais, il ne faut pas mettre d'espace entre le dernier mot et la ponctuation, seulement après.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: A space is placed after the last word and before a colon, semi-colon, exclamation point and question mark; spaces are placed before and after quotation marks.
rules.rule_summary: En français, il faut mettre une espace avant les deux-points, points-virgules, points d'exclamation et d'interrogation, et avant/après les guillemets.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: Spaces are only placed before the opening mark and after the closing mark (if it is not followed by other punctuation).
rules.rule_summary: En anglais, les espaces ne sont placées qu'avant le guillemet ouvrant et après le guillemet fermant (sauf si suivi d'une autre ponctuation).

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: Spaces are placed before and after quotation marks.
rules.rule_summary: En français, il faut placer des espaces avant et après les guillemets.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: Double quotation marks ("") are used for quotations and single ('') quotation marks are used for quotes within quotations.
rules.rule_summary: En anglais, les guillemets doubles servent aux citations et les simples aux citations dans les citations.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: French quotation marks (" ") are used for quotations and English double quotation marks (" ") are used for quotes within quotes.
rules.rule_summary: En français, les guillemets français servent aux citations et les guillemets anglais aux citations dans les citations.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: Punctuation appears inside quotation marks if it concludes the phrase or sentence.
rules.rule_summary: En anglais, la ponctuation se place à l'intérieur des guillemets si elle termine la phrase.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 2013 + ALT x > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: Punctuation appears outside quotation marks regardless of whether it concludes the phrase or sentence.
rules.rule_summary: En français, la ponctuation se place à l'extérieur des guillemets, même si elle termine la phrase.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations
rules.rule_text: It is essential to correctly format your quotations and cite their sources.
rules.rule_summary: Les citations doivent être correctement formatées et leurs sources citées.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > General rules
rules.rule_text: In order to avoid plagiarism, always fully cite your sources.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut toujours citer intégralement ses sources pour éviter le plagiat.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > Long quotes
rules.rule_text: Use a separate, indented paragraph for quotes of more than five lines.
rules.rule_summary: Les citations de plus de cinq lignes doivent être présentées dans un paragraphe séparé et en retrait.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > Long quotes
rules.rule_text: Use the correct O.N.E Author style for long quotes and do not add quotation marks.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut utiliser le style O.N.E Author pour les longues citations et ne pas ajouter de guillemets.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > Long quotes
rules.rule_text: Insert the author name in the "Reference Management" tool in Word™. The reference number will be automatically generated when the reference is added to your bibliography.
rules.rule_summary: Le nom de l’auteur doit être saisi dans l’outil de gestion des références de Word™ pour générer automatiquement le numéro de référence.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > Long quotes
rules.rule_text: Cite the source in parentheses at the end of the quote and do not put a full stop after the citation.
rules.rule_summary: La source doit être citée entre parenthèses à la fin de la citation, sans point final après la citation.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > Short quotes
rules.rule_text: Insert quotes of five lines or less into the running text, using double quotation marks (" ") and in-text citation.
rules.rule_summary: Les citations de cinq lignes ou moins doivent être insérées dans le texte courant, entre guillemets doubles et accompagnées d'une citation dans le texte.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > Quotations and punctuation
rules.rule_text: Place punctuation inside the quotation marks if the quote ends the clause or sentence; place outside the quotation marks if not.
rules.rule_summary: Punctuation must be placed inside quotation marks if the quote ends the clause or sentence, and outside if not.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > Quotations and punctuation
rules.rule_text: Use single quotation marks ('') for quotes of more than one word within quotes.
rules.rule_summary: Single quotation marks must be used for quotes of more than one word within other quotes.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > Quotations and punctuation
rules.rule_text: Replace omitted words or phrases with an ellipsis ( ... ); replace omitted paragraphs with an ellipsis in square brackets ([ ... ]).
rules.rule_summary: Omitted words or phrases must be replaced with an ellipsis, and omitted paragraphs with an ellipsis in square brackets.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > Quotations and punctuation
rules.rule_text: Place square brackets "[ ]" around that has been added to the quotation.
rules.rule_summary: Square brackets must be used to indicate text added to a quotation.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > Quotations and punctuation
rules.rule_text: Use a capital letter to start the quote if the quote is at the start of the sentence or if it follows a colon. Use a lowercase letter if the quote is part of a run on phrase.
rules.rule_summary: A capital letter must start a quote at the beginning of a sentence or after a colon; use lowercase if the quote is part of a run-on phrase.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: Double quote marks ("example") are placed around quotes and single quote marks ('example') are used for quotes within quotes.
rules.rule_summary: In English, double quotes must be used for quotations and single quotes for quotations within quotations.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: Double quote marks called "guillemets" (" example ") are placed around quotes and English style double quote marks ("example") are used for quotes within quotes.
rules.rule_summary: In French, guillemets must be used for quotations and English style double quotes for quotations within quotations.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: When reporting direct speech, the comma is placed before the closing quotation mark.
rules.rule_summary: In English, the comma must be placed before the closing quotation mark in direct speech.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 12 Quotations > Key differences between English and French
rules.rule_text: When reporting direct speech, the comma is placed after the closing quotation mark.
rules.rule_summary: In French, the comma must be placed after the closing quotation mark in direct speech.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > British English spelling
rules.rule_text: Use British English spelling in all OECD content.
rules.rule_summary: Tous les contenus de l'OCDE doivent utiliser l'orthographe britannique.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > British English spelling
rules.rule_text: The Concise Oxford English Dictionary is the OECD's dictionary of choice.
rules.rule_summary: Le dictionnaire de référence pour l'OCDE est le Concise Oxford English Dictionary.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > British English spelling
rules.rule_text: Set your language in Word™ to "English (United Kingdom)".
rules.rule_summary: La langue dans Word doit être réglée sur "English (United Kingdom)".

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > British English spelling
rules.rule_text: Use "-ise" endings, not "-ize" ("organise", "realise").
rules.rule_summary: Il faut utiliser les terminaisons en "-ise" au lieu de "-ize".

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > British English spelling
rules.rule_text: Use "-our" endings, not "-or" ("labour", "honour").
rules.rule_summary: Il faut utiliser les terminaisons en "-our" au lieu de "-or".

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > British English spelling
rules.rule_text: Use "-re" endings, not "er" ("centre", "metre").
rules.rule_summary: Il faut utiliser les terminaisons en "-re" au lieu de "-er".

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > British English spelling
rules.rule_text: Use double consonants when adding endings to words ("travelling", "focussed", "labelled").
rules.rule_summary: Il faut doubler les consonnes lors de l'ajout de terminaisons à certains mots.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > British English spelling
rules.rule_text: Respect the use of American spelling in the names of US institutions or of institutions that use US spelling.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut respecter l'orthographe américaine dans les noms d'institutions américaines ou utilisant cette orthographe.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Choosing the right words
rules.rule_text: Use clear, simple language to communicate effectively with audiences who might not be native English speakers or experts in the subject.
rules.rule_summary: Utilisez un langage clair et simple pour communiquer efficacement avec des publics non experts ou non anglophones.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Choosing the right words
rules.rule_text: Avoid foreign words and expressions (ceteris paribus, inter alia, ipso facto). They make your writing harder to understand and alternatives exist in English ("other things being equal", "among other things", "by the fact of").
rules.rule_summary: Évitez les mots et expressions étrangères ; privilégiez les alternatives anglaises pour plus de clarté.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Choosing the right words
rules.rule_text: Be aware that some words in English may be pronounced or spelt similarly yet have very different meanings or may have similar yet not interchangeable meanings. Refer to the table "Commonly confused English words".
rules.rule_summary: Soyez attentif aux mots anglais similaires en orthographe ou prononciation mais différents en sens ; consultez le tableau des mots couramment confondus.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Choosing the right words
rules.rule_text: Take care to choose the word that actually expresses your meaning. The table "Commonly misused words in English" helps you to navigate key English words are often that are often used incorrectly.
rules.rule_summary: Veillez à choisir le mot qui exprime réellement votre intention ; consultez le tableau des mots anglais souvent mal utilisés.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Choosing the right words
rules.rule_text: Note that some words in English and French share the same meaning but are not spelt exactly the same. The table "Commonly confused spellings of similar words in English and French" highlights key examples of this.
rules.rule_summary: Notez que certains mots anglais et français ont le même sens mais une orthographe différente ; consultez le tableau des orthographes similaires.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly confused English words
rules.rule_text: to inform (but use of this verb should be avoided)
rules.rule_summary: L'usage du verbe 'apprise' pour signifier 'informer' doit être évité.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly confused English words
rules.rule_text: remainder (noun) what is left after something has been subtracted or used (but should be avoided; prefer rest)
rules.rule_summary: L'utilisation du mot 'remainder' devrait être évitée au profit de 'rest'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly confused English words
rules.rule_text: These words are imprecise and can sound informal. Avoid them.
rules.rule_summary: Les mots 'quite', 'rather' et 'somewhat' doivent être évités car ils sont imprécis et informels.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly confused English words
rules.rule_text: These words break the flow of the reader's eye movement as the reader must look back in the sentence to see the connection between the words. Avoid them.
rules.rule_summary: Les mots 'respectively', 'latter' et 'former' doivent être évités car ils nuisent à la fluidité de la lecture.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Be specific. "The report compared the unemployment data of several countries."
rules.rule_summary: It is required to be specific when using the word 'across' to avoid ambiguity.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Imprecise. Replace with a more specific word such as "discuss" or "investigate".
rules.rule_summary: Replace 'address' with a more specific word like 'discuss' or 'investigate'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Always two words. "Alright" is incorrect.
rules.rule_summary: The correct form is 'all right' (two words); 'alright' is incorrect.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Do not use. Rephrase to "A or B, or both".
rules.rule_summary: Do not use 'and/or'; rephrase as 'A or B, or both'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Always use. Do not use "appendix".
rules.rule_summary: Always use 'annex' and do not use 'appendix'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Not a synonym for "contain" or "include". Do not use "is comprised of"; this is incorrect.
rules.rule_summary: Do not use 'is comprised of'; 'comprise' is not a synonym for 'contain' or 'include'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Must be used to refer to one or more countries, institutions or individuals; one alone cannot make a concerted effort.
rules.rule_summary: 'Concerted' must refer to multiple entities; it cannot describe the effort of a single entity.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Means "shared opinion", not "majority view".
rules.rule_summary: 'Consensus' means shared opinion, not majority view.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Not to be confused with "contain": "This report contains the group's findings, the result of three years of work" (correct) but "This report constitutes three years of work" (incorrect).
rules.rule_summary: Do not confuse 'constitute' with 'contain'; use each word according to its correct meaning.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Do not use as a verb: "The policy had a direct impact on pollution" (correct) but "The policy impacted pollution" (incorrect).
rules.rule_summary: Do not use 'impact' as a verb.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Much overused, employ synonyms when possible.
rules.rule_summary: Use synonyms for 'implement' when possible to avoid overuse.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: "In regard to" is the proper expression; use "regard" (with no "s") rather than "regards".
rules.rule_summary: Use 'in regard to' and 'regard' (not 'regards') as the correct expressions.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Do not use the phrase "including but not limited to"; it is redundant.
rules.rule_summary: Do not use 'including but not limited to'; it is considered redundant.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Only use in this sense. Does not mean "in effect" or "virtually". "He literally exploded" would mean there were bits of him all over the walls, floor and ceiling. Do not use metaphorically.
rules.rule_summary: Use 'literally' only for literal meanings; do not use it metaphorically.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Do not use as a verb, use "lend".
rules.rule_summary: Do not use 'loan' as a verb; use 'lend' instead.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Do not use, to avoid confusion between the difference in its meaning between British English ("soon") and American English ("now").
rules.rule_summary: Do not use 'presently' to avoid confusion between British and American English meanings.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Do not use "irregardless"; it is a double negative and is not equivalent to "regardless".
rules.rule_summary: Do not use 'irregardless'; use 'regardless' instead.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Do not use in this context.
rules.rule_summary: Do not use 'regime' to refer to the government of a country, as it is pejorative.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Does not mean "frequent".
rules.rule_summary: 'Regular' means at regular intervals, not frequent.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Do not use as it carries a negative connotation of "sneaky" or "devious" in American English. Use instead a word that is neutral in both British and American English ("programme", "project", "plan" or "initiative").
rules.rule_summary: Do not use 'scheme'; use a neutral term like 'programme', 'project', 'plan', or 'initiative'.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Do not use, to avoid confusion between the difference in its meaning between British English ("severely criticised") and in American English ("scheduled").
rules.rule_summary: Do not use 'slated' to avoid confusion between British and American English meanings.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Be careful to clarify your meaning, as "state" can be confusing in discussions involving countries with federal governments, such as the United States and Germany.
rules.rule_summary: Clarify the meaning of 'state' to avoid confusion, especially in federal contexts.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Commonly misused words in English
rules.rule_text: Do not use, to avoid confusion between the difference in its meaning between British English ("to present something") and in American English ("to take off the agenda").
rules.rule_summary: Do not use 'table' as a verb to avoid confusion between British and American English.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Plurals
rules.rule_text: Use the correct ending when making a noun plural.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut utiliser la terminaison correcte pour former le pluriel d’un nom.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Plurals
rules.rule_text: Consult the Concise Oxford English Dictionary if you are unsure of which form to use.
rules.rule_summary: Il est recommandé de consulter le Concise Oxford English Dictionary en cas de doute sur la forme à utiliser.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 13 Spelling and usage > Plurals
rules.rule_text: Use a singular verb form if a mass noun is the subject of the sentence.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut utiliser la forme verbale singulière si le sujet de la phrase est un nom massif.

rules.section_title: Préambule > Singular and plural forms of Latin or Greek terms commonly used in English
rules.rule_text: data (always plural)
rules.rule_summary: Le mot 'data' doit toujours être utilisé au pluriel.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 14 Translation and terms in other languages > AGORA translation portal
rules.rule_text: Use AGORA to: Check the exact meaning of a term or expression.
rules.rule_summary: Il est recommandé d'utiliser AGORA pour vérifier la signification exacte d'un terme ou d'une expression.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 14 Translation and terms in other languages > AGORA translation portal
rules.rule_text: Use AGORA to: Find out exactly how to describe a concept or how to translate it.
rules.rule_summary: Il est recommandé d'utiliser AGORA pour savoir comment décrire ou traduire précisément un concept.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 14 Translation and terms in other languages > AGORA translation portal
rules.rule_text: Use AGORA to: Suggest a translation or terms for inclusion.
rules.rule_summary: Il est recommandé d'utiliser AGORA pour suggérer une traduction ou des termes à inclure.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 14 Translation and terms in other languages > Word count coefficients for translation
rules.rule_text: Keep this coefficient in mind when drafting content, particularly for web and social media, as a term that fits into your layout in one language may not in another.
rules.rule_summary: Il est recommandé de prendre en compte le coefficient de comptage des mots lors de la rédaction de contenu, surtout pour le web et les réseaux sociaux.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 14 Translation and terms in other languages > Using titles, terms and expressions from other languages
rules.rule_text: Avoid foreign words and expressions when commonly understood alternatives exist in English.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut éviter les mots et expressions étrangères lorsqu'il existe des alternatives couramment comprises en anglais.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 14 Translation and terms in other languages > Using titles, terms and expressions from other languages
rules.rule_text: Put all titles, terms or expressions from other languages into italics, except for common abbreviations and proper names (Deutsche Bundesbank).
rules.rule_summary: Tous les titres, termes ou expressions d'autres langues doivent être en italique, sauf les abréviations courantes et les noms propres.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 14 Translation and terms in other languages > Using titles, terms and expressions from other languages
rules.rule_text: Provide an English translation for titles and terms from other languages and put the translation in parentheses afterwards or use the English translation and put the original title or term in parentheses after it. Be consistent in which style you use.
rules.rule_summary: Il faut fournir une traduction anglaise pour les titres et termes étrangers, en la mettant entre parenthèses après l'original ou inversement, et il faut être cohérent dans le style choisi.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 14 Translation and terms in other languages > Don't
rules.rule_text: X Use terms from Latin when a simple English equivalent is available.
rules.rule_summary: Il est interdit d'utiliser des termes latins lorsqu'un équivalent anglais simple existe.

rules.section_title: Préambule > 14 Translation and terms in other languages > Latin terms to avoid
rules.rule_text: Avoid
rules.rule_summary: L'utilisation des termes latins doit être évitée.
